title_zh: 核对企业申请表的主体和收入栏

scenario.label_zh: 核对小企业申请表的主体与收入栏
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清申请主体和收入栏均应填公司资料而非个人资料，并确认提交申请不等于获得资助

context_zh: 虚构小企业资助咨询台依据手头表格说明字段，不提供真实财务或法律建议。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Our catering enterprise wants to apply for this grant. Is the applicant me or the company?

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: The guide says to name the entity seeking the grant. Since the company would receive it, use the company's details.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Then the earnings box is asking for the company's figure, not my personal pay?

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Correct. The form labels that box "company earnings for the last financial year".

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: If we complete all the boxes, does that entitle us to the money?

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: No. It allows the application to be assessed; it does not guarantee an award.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Thanks. I will check the company records before entering the figure, and I will not treat this as approved funding.
